steps.title: What this does
steps.confirm: I understand what it can see and do.
steps.body:
Keeps a copy of every nightly backup in your Google Drive.

**What it can see:** It uses Google's per-file permission: My Maestro can see and change only the files it creates, its backup folder and the backups in it, nothing else in your Drive.

Backups are encrypted before they leave this computer.

Each person registers their own Google app once. That takes about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Register your Google app
steps.confirm: I registered the app and have its Client ID and Client secret.
steps.body:
Do these on Google's site:

1. Open the first link below with the Google account whose Drive will hold the backups and create a project, for example "My Maestro backups".
2. Turn on the Google Drive API for it (second link), then click Enable.
3. Google Auth Platform (third link): on a new project it first shows Get started, one form that asks for the app name ("My Maestro"), your email, the audience and the contact details. Internal exists only for Google Workspace accounts (an address at your own domain); personal Gmail accounts choose External.
4. Audience (fourth link): on an External app, click Publish app. While an External app is in Testing, Google ends its sign-ins after 7 days. This permission doesn't need Google's review.
5. Data Access (fifth link): Add or remove scopes, tick ".../auth/drive.file" (See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app), Update, Save.
6. Clients (sixth link): Create client, Application type "TVs and Limited Input devices", any name, Create. Copy the Client ID and the Client secret for the next step.

If a link doesn't open the right page, search for "Google Auth Platform" in the console's search bar.

steps.title: Client ID and secret
steps.body: Paste the Client ID and the Client secret from the last step.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in with the Google account whose Drive should hold the backups, by approving the code on any phone or computer.
